facts.fact: TechTrendsKE reports that Kenya's Office of the Data Protection Commissioner is operating under Commissioner Immaculate Kassait, who is leaving after six years, with President Ruto's nominee Lydia Sitienei Chelagat submitted to the National Assembly on 9 November 2026.

facts.fact: TechTrendsKE reports outgoing Commissioner Kassait as saying the ODPC has handled more than 13,000 complaints, issued 459 determinations and taken 206 enforcement and penalty notice actions over its six years, with about 28,000 controllers and processors registered.

facts.fact: TechTrendsKE reports that Kenya's Data Protection Act is applied by the Data Protection Commissioner and the High Court, with Section 65 giving a right to compensation for damage from a contravention.
TechTrendsKE reports that the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner is operating under Commissioner Immaculate Kassait, with a successor nominated on 9 November 2026.

facts.fact: TechTrendsKE reports that Regulation 14(3)(e) under the Act, which provides for compensation, stands after Justice Francis Andayi's judgment declined to strike it down.

facts.fact: TechTrendsKE reports that Justice Francis Andayi of the High Court set aside the ODPC's KSh1.25 million compensation award against a Nairobi healthcare business over CCTV in an examination room, finding the Act does not expressly empower the Commissioner to award damages; the date of judgment is not stated.
